name: LevelCheck clinical cohort (Johns Hopkins, Siewerdsen group)

pairing.ct: the preoperative CT of each patient
pairing.pose: not shipped; each level is placed by registration to the CT
pairing.masks: levels labelled on the preoperative CT
pairing.annotate: to read once the set is in hand

what: 178 patients with preoperative CT and 398 intraoperative radiographs (De Silva et al., Spine 2016), plus Ketcha et al. 2017's 24 thoracolumbar patients with 61 Carestream DRX-1 radiographs, and the 62-image reader set of Manbachi et al. 2018; neither paper has a data statement
level_truth: the level of each vertebra on the radiograph, placed by registration to the labelled preoperative CT

segmentations.masks: not recorded: the papers label the levels on the preoperative CT and do not say whether masks come with it

licence: not recorded; a data use agreement with the PI is the route
how_to_get: Write to Jeffrey Siewerdsen (MD Anderson, Surgical Data Science, since 2022), copying the JHU co-authors still there (Ali Uneri, Wojciech Zbijewski, J. Webster Stayman), addresses from the institutional directories, to confirm; the letter is letters/levelcheck_jhu.md.
A yes brings a data use agreement with Johns Hopkins or MD Anderson, which the owner signs, then a transfer by link, fetched as a grid job on the owner's word.
record: SchwingNet docs/research/xray-dataset-requests.md section 15 (2026-10-21); no record under SchwingNet's data/sources/ existed for this set, so this one was written from that section
source_status: a letter sent 2026-10-21; no record in SchwingNet's registry yet
